title: Choking
subtitle: Adult
summary: Five back blows, then five abdominal thrusts, repeating. Follows the 2025 AHA adult FBAO algorithm, which reversed the previous abdominal-thrusts-first guidance.

steps.speech: First. Is it safe where you are?

steps.detail: You cannot help anyone if you are hurt. Move to safety, then call 911.
steps.speech: Get yourself clear first. You cannot help if you are hurt. Then call nine one one.

steps.detail: A strong cough means the airway is still partly open.
steps.speech: Can they cough, or speak? Look at them.
steps.quote: Check for signs of severe FBAO: Weak or absence of cough / Unable to speak / Change in colour (cyanosis) / Altered mental status / Apnea

steps.detail: Do not hit them. Do not reach into the mouth. Stay with them and watch.
steps.speech: Let them cough. Do not hit them. Do not reach into their mouth. Stay with them.
steps.quote: Encourage cough. Continue to check for signs of severe FBAO.

steps.detail: Watch for the cough going quiet, lips turning blue, or them going limp.
steps.quote: Continue to check for signs of severe FBAO.

steps.detail: Say out loud: "YOU — call 911 right now. Put it on speaker."
steps.speech: Point at one person. Say: you. Call nine one one, right now. Put it on speaker.

steps.detail: Speaker on. Put the phone down beside you and keep going.
steps.speech: Call nine one one. Put it on speaker, set the phone down, and keep going.

steps.detail: Heel of your hand. Hard. Between the shoulder blades.
steps.speech: Five back blows. Heel of your hand. Hard. Between the shoulder blades.
steps.quote: Start repeated cycles of 5 back blows (slaps), followed by 5 abdominal thrusts

steps.detail: Fist above the navel. Grab it with your other hand. Pull sharply in and up.
steps.speech: Five thrusts. Fist just above the navel. Pull sharply in and up.
steps.quote: 5 back blows (slaps), followed by 5 abdominal thrusts

steps.detail: Fist on the breastbone. Pull straight back. Not on the belly.
steps.speech: Five chest thrusts instead. Fist on the breastbone. Pull straight back.
steps.quote: For patients in the late stages of pregnancy, or when the rescuer is unable to encircle the patient's abdomen, 5 chest thrusts should be used instead.

steps.detail: If the object came out and they are breathing, stop and stay with them.
steps.quote: Repeat until object is expelled or the adult becomes unresponsive.

steps.detail: They still need to be seen by a doctor. Abdominal thrusts can injure organs. Watch their breathing until help arrives.
steps.speech: Good. Stay with them. They still need to see a doctor, even now. Keep watching their breathing.
steps.quote: If object is expelled, continue to monitor until advanced care arrives.

steps.detail: Lower them to the floor. Begin compressions.
steps.speech: Lower them to the floor. We are starting C P R now.
steps.quote: Start CPR until advanced care arrives; refer to adult BLS algorithm. Start with compressions. Check for visible object in mouth before giving breaths.
